x_failures: Attributes the quoted words 'impostorous' and 'superstitious' to Libavius and cites Croll p.397. That page only says Libavius 'insults and rails against' the salve; those words come from Goclenius p.103. X also says Goclenius credited Paracelsus as inventor, but Saltzmann p.7 says Goclenius denied Paracelsus was the author.
reason: Y's Comenius, Porta, Croll and Boyle quotations all appear on the cited pages, and its claims stay within what those pages say. X covers more ground but misattributes a quotation to Libavius and misstates Goclenius's position on who invented the salve.
